messages:
sara: Hey, getting customer escalation — sustained 5xx / timeouts from hosted API for ~20m. Support ticket #8472. Logs show RequestQueue depth hitting soft_limit then a cascade of 502/504s. sample request ids: rq_8a2f, rq_8a30, rq_8a33

support-bot: Noted. Customer reports ~30% of requests returning 504s, p95 latency skyrocketed. No auth/billing errors reported.

nate: I can see continuous-batcher backlog on cluster cluster-us-east-1: batcher-pool-7 shows backlog_count > 1200 and longest_wait ~22s. Queue depth limit is 1024.

kevin: Can you paste the batcher logs around the moment the queue crossed threshold? Also any recent deploys?

sara: Log excerpt: ```
2026-03-16T21:14:02Z [batcher] enqueue rq_8a2f len=1024 soft_limit=1024 drop_policy=evict_oldest
2026-03-16T21:14:04Z [batcher] start_drain mode=continuous reason=kv-cache-warmup
2026-03-16T21:14:26Z [batcher] batch_exec latency=18.2s tokens=128 status=ok
2026-03-16T21:14:26Z [gateway] reject rq_8a30 code=504 reason=queue_timeout
2026-03-16T21:14:34Z [batcher] backlog_spin stalled_for=16s
```

julia: I noticed a config change earlier today to continuous batching aggressiveness (PR #9039) — it increased max_batch_wait from 10ms to 80ms for KV cache warmup path. Could be amplifying queueing.

alex: @julia that's the likely trigger. Increasing max wait means batches fill more which is good for throughput normally, but if kv-cache warmup stalls it creates long head-of-line delays. We should roll the change back on hosted for affected pool.

support-bot: Customer impact: several endpoints (chat.generate) returned partial streams then 504. They captured a failing sample: curl with streaming got an early EOF.

nate: Quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_batch_wait back to 10ms on cluster-us-east-1 2) lower queue_soft_limit to 800 to avoid long-tail build-up 3) enable canary routing to fallback smaller model for the impacted customer (avoid heavy KV warmup).

kevin: Agreed. Also add an emergency healthcheck to detect batcher spin (backlog_spin > 10s) and return 429 early instead of 504 so consumers can retry faster.

deploy-bot: Rolling config change to batcher-pool-7: set max_batch_wait=10ms, queue_soft_limit=800 (rolling restart).

oncall-bot: Alerting changed: create pager if backlog_count > 600 for 3 consecutive minutes.

julia: Doing the rollback now, patch coming in ~2m. If the rollback fixes it we'll schedule a follow-up to tune warmup heuristics instead of a blunt increase. :thumbsup:

sara: After rollback, observed backlog_count falling, 504 rate dropped from 28% -> 4% over 6 minutes. Customer notified and provided repro steps. Keeping this thread open for postmortem.

kevin: Postmortem TODOs: - revert config change in feature branch + add load test for kv-cache warmup scenario - add metric for longest_wait_per_request - update runbook to include early-429 option - communicate change to Hosted customers about potential batching tuning.

support-bot: Customer updated to confirm behavior improved. Closing immediate escalation but flagging for postmortem and customer follow-up.

alex: Nice work. Please include the deploy id and exact timestamps in the incident doc. We'll flesh out the RCA and long-term mitigations in a separate doc.

sara: Deploy id: deploy-2026-03-16-34fa. Recording notes in incidents tracker. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
